title: Cada vez que vs siempre que: habitualidad vs restricción
goal: Contrast iterative frequency in indicative (cada vez que) with restrictive conditionality in subjunctive (siempre que).
grammar: Habitualidad iterativa frente a restricción condicional: cada vez que y siempre que

sections.title: Unit 7: Temporal Subordination — Lesson 4
body: Welcome to lesson 4 of Unit 7 (Temporal Subordination & Future Prospections). Mastering the boundary between indicative and subjunctive in temporal clauses is a hallmark of upper-intermediate fluency.
In this lesson, we analyze cada vez que vs siempre que: habitualidad vs restricción, establishing precise temporal coordination across complex sentences.

items: Contrast iterative frequency in indicative (cada vez que) with restrictive conditionality in subjunctive (siempre que).
Incorporate advanced temporal vocabulary (la reiteración, recurrente).
